name: Buffet Mac & Cheese, Plain Pasta & Chicken Tenders
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: The kids' buffet station always stocks ultra-mild white-flour mac & cheese, plain penne pasta (with butter/parmesan nearby), and golden chicken breast tenders with zero spice.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab plain pasta with butter/parmesan or smooth mac & cheese from the kids' counter, plus steamed white rice and ripe cantaloupe/honeydew melon from the fruit station.
watchOuts: Dairy milk in mac & cheese sauce if lactose sensitive
Fryer oil on chicken tenders during an active flare
